purpose: Formal-structure test of the secp256k1 sigma walk for proof.md Section 2 (D1), Lemma C' (2-cycle rate 1/(6A)) and the degenerate-pair check. Small builds replayed on real secp256k1 points with exact formal coefficients per walk point; not a production-size run.

parameters.trail_ends: distinguished point, abandonment after CAP_PERIODS anchors

i_longer_closures.note: formal closures W_{k+1} = W_{k+1-l} at candidate steps, counted at every step they persist (until the walk detects and escapes them) and as entries; predicted entry rate 1/(18A^2) for l=3 (three equal indices, unit sum zero: 12 of 216 ordered unit triples) and 1/(36A^2) for l=4 (indices abab, both pairs cancel); the adjacent 4-patterns contain a 2-cycle and are pre-empted by its escape
